nom: Dr. Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I don't think this one is as good as the Clinic or Banila Co. brands but it's good and I like the component. It's more hygienic than the one you use a spatula for. I think this is a good product and I'm happy to have it. Not beefing my favorites but worth a buy.
The cleansing balm does take off all my heavy face makeup and mascara. But it inky lasts about two weeks.

I've tried so many oil cleansers and balms. This one is the absolute best. It has a great dispenser that doesnt allow for cross contamination. It really gets everything off, even on a fulk beat, even with waterproof mascara.

Ive tried a lot of K beauty and US cleansing balms and this is by far my favorite. It doesnt leave a film/residue and easily removes makeup and sunscreen. I also love the hygenic mechanism since I don't like scooping product with my fingers. I have very sensitive skin and my skin has had no issues with this product. The only thing it doesnt remove as well is waterproof mascara, but I've yet to find a cleansing balm that works as well as micellar water for that particular makeup product. So that's not a dealbreaker for me. Overall highly recommend!

I got this for my birthday and it's a really good product. However, it stopped working after a couple weeks or so there was no more product left inside and the mechanism to open it to get the cleanser was broken. Needless to say, I was disappointed.

I love this cleansing balm!!!! Whenver i wear makeup and use this product the next day i never get any breakouts!! Again the way i use it is by applying the balm to my face with my makeup on THEN wash it off with my cleanser. I believe thats the best way to use it and i deffff reccomend

Such a great middle-ground priced cleansing balm!! So smooth and high quality. The other reviewers don't seem to understand that cleansing balm should be used alone without water first, then followed by your usual cleanser. Also love the dispenser!
It madd me break out so much. It might help others but its not for me. I loved the relief cream but not the cleanser.

avis.titre: Love the packaging but it didn't take off my makeup.
avis.texte: I ended up returning this because it didn't remove my mascara, eyeliner, and powder bronzer with lukewarm or semi hot water. I've tried other items similiar but this wasn't it. I love their Barrier Cream and Vitamin C serum though!
I was looking for an alternative to remove my makeup because micellar water was irritating me. It worked well for me but you need to follow it up with a cleanser and moisturizer
So smooth to use and works very well. The dispensing mechanism is fun.
